name: settings
description: Manage this server’s Twitch and social notification settings.

menu.placeholder: Choose what you want to configure

pages.overview:
{{notice}}## Server settings
Manage Twitch live notifications and subscriptions to feeds, videos and social accounts.
**Current notifications:** {{count}}
Choose Twitch or a social provider below. Each subscription keeps its own Discord channel, message and filters.
Use `/subscriptions <provider> add` for advanced filters and `/subscriptions instagram connect` or `/subscriptions tiktok connect` to authorize Instagram or TikTok.
pages.manage_one:
{{notice}}## Manage Twitch notifications
This server currently has **{{count}}** configured notification.
Select one or more below to remove them, or reset everything.
pages.manage_other:
{{notice}}## Manage Twitch notifications
This server currently has **{{count}}** configured notifications.

pages.test:
{{notice}}## Test a notification
Select a notification below to send a preview through the same delivery path used by real Twitch events, so you can verify the channel and bot permissions.
pages.twitch:
{{notice}}## Server settings › Twitch live
Add subscriptions for live or offline events, manage existing subscriptions or send a test notification. Videos and clips have their own provider sections.
